title: docs/ai-rsc: model gpt-4-turbo does not exist
body:
### Description

Simply copying & pasting the example from concepts/generative-ui uses the `gpt-4-turbo` model which doesn't exist, should be updated to either `gpt-4-0125-preview` which is the latest gpt-4-turbo checkpoint.

```json
  error: {
    message: 'The model `gpt-4-turbo` does not exist',
    type: 'invalid_request_error',
    param: null,
    code: 'model_not_found'
  },
```

linked_prs.title: docs: updated the model from gpt-4-turbo to the latest checkpoint that works

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue is about using an unsupported LLM model name ("gpt-4-turbo") in an agent system, which matches the "Unsupported models" sub-category under "Incompatibility with LLM providers" in the agent issue taxonomy.
